motion.purpose: Clip-path changes from inset(0 0 12% 0) to inset(0 0 0 0); reduced motion disables animation and transitions.

metadata.purpose: Final cascade normalizes status, captions, topic metadata, and footer status to 14px. Decorative aria-hidden worksheet paper label is a separate 9px exception.

narrative.overview: An approachable educational institution with scientific discipline. Light space, strong green typography, quiet rules, and purposeful imagery express the approved Open Corners direction. Opposing corners suggest room for learning and inquiry.
keyCharacteristics: Evologics green on broad light surfaces
Flat editorial bands and ruled links

rules.name: Decorative miniature type
rules.body: The 9px paper label is confined to aria-hidden worksheet artwork; meaningful resource text remains outside that artwork.

rules.name: Print structure
rules.body: Print notice and writing-rule grays are output-only structural colors; do not introduce them as screen branding.

dos: Preserve the approved logo, local Ubuntu files, and image provenance.
Keep focus states, reduced motion, meaningful labels, and accurate preview status.
donts: Do not treat fictional illustrative people as actual beneficiaries or staff.
Do not add unsupported clinical, entity, grant, or accreditation claims.
